q: Furthermore, as the reader may know, the Hebrew text's k'tiv (written tradition) and k'rei (reading tradition) differ for occasional words; where this occurs, our edition first prints that word's k'tiv letters in small type, followed by the pointed k'rei letters in normal text type.
2001, David L. Lieber, Jules Harlow, Etz Hayim: Torah and Commentary, page xix:

e: From k- + rad, K = one thousand times rad from hacker and skateboarding slang.
